rules: Preserve source user-export files and all old ratings
4star means improve photograph of exact painting, not replace artwork
3star means provisional current painting pending better user-approved alternative
Candidate original source is not equivalent to approved photo master
Do not mis-bind London NG6276 high-resolution Dream of Saint Joseph to Louvre INV20450; same artist/theme but different physical paintings.
Different Commons filenames or large EXIF original dimensions are not proof of independent master photo.

For W02-015 National Gallery NG5655, the 2012 Commons historical 3554×4226 file is a same-painting higher resolution revision. A revision is not an independent camera photograph; user may rate as upgraded variant.
